dish_name_kh: សម្លចាប់ឆាយ
dish_name_en: Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup)

ingredients.raw_kh: សាច់ជ្រូកបីជាន់
ស្បែកជ្រូកបំពង
ផ្សិតត្រចៀកកណ្តុរ
ថ្លើមជ្រូក
ពោះវៀនជ្រូក

steps.text_kh: សាច់ជ្រូកហាន់ជាបន្ទះស្តើងៗ
steps.text_en: Slice the pork into thin strips.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 1: Slice the pork into thin strips.

steps.text_kh: ពោះវៀនកាត់ជាកង់ៗ
steps.text_en: Cut the intestines into short rings.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 2: Cut the intestines into short rings.

steps.text_kh: ថ្លើមហាន់ជាបន្ទះស្តើងៗ
steps.text_en: Slice the liver into thin strips.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 3: Slice the liver into thin strips.

steps.text_kh: ហៃប៊ី យីហុ ត្រាំទឹក យីហុហាន់ជាចំណិតៗ
steps.text_en: Soak the lily buds and wood ear mushrooms in water; slice the wood ear into thin strips.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 4: Soak the lily buds and wood ear mushrooms in water; slice the wood ear into thin strips.

steps.text_kh: ផ្សិតត្រចៀកកណ្តុរកាត់ជាបន្ទះៗដែរ ផ្កាស្ពៃកាត់ជាកង់ៗដែរ ស្បែកជ្រូកបកសម្បកចេញកាត់ជាកង់ៗដែរ មាន់កាប់ជាដុំៗល្មមហូប
steps.text_en: Cut the straw mushrooms, cauliflower, and peeled crispy pork skin into pieces; cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 5: Cut the straw mushrooms, cauliflower, and peeled crispy pork skin into pieces; cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

steps.text_kh: ឆ្នាំងដាក់ខ្លាញ់ក្តៅ ដាក់ខ្ទឹមសចិញ្ច្រាំឱ្យក្រហម រួចដាក់សាច់ជ្រូក សាច់មាន់ឆាចូលគ្នាឱ្យឆ្អិន ចាក់ទឹកត្រី អំបិល ស្ករ ម្សៅស៊ុប ដាក់បន្លែទាំងអស់ចូលជាមួយគ្នា ចាក់ទឹកល្មមលិចបន្លែឱ្យពុះរួចលើកចុះ រោយម្រេចជាការស្រេច
steps.text_en: Heat a pot with oil, fry minced garlic until golden, add pork and chicken and stir-fry until cooked, season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder, add all vegetables, pour in enough water to cover and bring to a boil, then finish with black pepper.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Chap Chhay (Mixed Meat and Vegetable Soup), step 6: Heat a pot with oil, fry minced garlic until golden, add pork and chicken and stir-fry until cooked, season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder, add all vegetables, pour in enough water to cover and bring to a boil, then finish with black pepper.
